## Goal
`SmtpImapMailer.fetch_since` (`engine/mail.py:345-370`) downloads each of up to 50 recent messages whole with `BODY.PEEK[]` (`mail.py:360`) and only afterwards do `scan_replies` and `_plain_text` cut them to `MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES` (`mail.py:67`, `mail.py:247`). A broker (or spam) message with a large attachment is therefore fully downloaded and parsed on every poll. Also, when one `fetch` raises, the whole call raises `MailError` and the messages already read are thrown away (`mail.py:366-369`). And the SINCE date is built with `strftime("%d-%b-%Y")` (`mail.py:356`), whose month name follows the process locale; IMAP wants English month names. Fix all three inside `fetch_since`: ask `RFC822.SIZE` first and skip messages over `MAX_MESSAGE_BYTES`, keep what was fetched if a later message fails (return the partial list), and format the date with a fixed English month list. The public signature and the `MailError` messages stay the same.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. With a fake IMAP connection whose message sizes are 1 KB, 5 MB and 1 KB, only the two small messages are fetched (the fake records every fetch command; no `BODY.PEEK[]` for the big one).
2. If the second of three fetches raises `imaplib.IMAP4.error`, the first message is returned and the third is not attempted; if the first fetch raises and nothing was read, `MailError("imap failed: IMAP4.error")`-style behaviour is unchanged (class name only).
3. The SEARCH command receives `01-Mar-2026`-style text for fixed dates in every month, and does so when the test sets a non-English `LC_TIME` locale (skip the locale part when the locale is not installed; the month-list part always runs).
4. `INBOX` is still opened read-only and `logout` still runs on every path (fake records both).
5. At most `MAX_MESSAGES` newest messages are considered, as today.
6. WO-331/341 tests, `tests/test_mail_sec50_53.py` and `tests/test_mail_tls_pin.py` pass unchanged.

**Limits (every Grok WO, CLAUDE-G-004):** offline only. No network, credentials, git or gh, installs, or running the real app against real sites or a real mailbox; never read anything outside the repo. Fake people only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests pass on Windows too (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`). Check `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/` and the in-house `tests/test_*.py` first; don't duplicate a guard.
